# Introduction

The **PLIER2** package provides a two-stage framework to extract interpretable latent variables from high-dimensional transcriptomic data. It combines a standard matrix decomposition (PLIERbase) with pathway-guided factor refinement (PLIERfull), enabling:

1. **Dimensionality reduction** of gene expression matrices  
2. **Incorporation of prior knowledge** (e.g., Gene Ontology or MSigDB)  
3. **Cross-validation** to select robust latent variables  

This vignette demonstrates three common use cases—small in-memory data, large HDF5 datasets with file-backed matrices, and tabular count files—illustrating how to preprocess, model, and interpret results with PLIER2.

## Overview of the package

```{r plier2-workflow-flowchart, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=16, fig.height=30}
library(DiagrammeR)

grViz('
digraph PLIER2_pipeline {
  graph [layout=dot, rankdir=TB, splines=ortho]

  // ---- Inputs & Priors (gray) ----
  DF     [shape=folder,   style=filled, fillcolor=Gray90, label="data.frame"]
  H5     [shape=folder,   style=filled, fillcolor=Gray90, label="H5 file"]
  GO     [shape=cylinder, style=filled, fillcolor=Gray90, label="GO Biological Process"]
  MSIGDB [shape=cylinder, style=filled, fillcolor=Gray90, label="MSigDB Hallmark"]
  GTEx   [shape=cylinder, style=filled, fillcolor=Gray90, label="GTEx Tissues"]

  // ---- Functions (white) ----
  node [shape=rectangle, style=filled, fillcolor=White]
  preDF      [label="preprocessPLIER2()"]
  zDF        [label="zscorePLIER2()"]
  svdDF      [label="rsvd()"]
  preFBM     [label="preprocessPLIER2FBM()"]
  zFBM       [label="zscorePLIER2FBM()"]
  svdFBM     [label="big_randomSVD()"]
  numpc      [label="num.pc()"]
  gmtList    [label="gmtListToSparseMat()"]
  matchPaths [label="getMatchedPathwayMat()"]
  chatFunc   [label="getChat()"]
  base       [label="PLIERbase()"]
  full       [label="PLIERfull()"]
  dotplot    [label="dotplotPLIER()"]

  // ---- Outputs (light‑blue tabs) ----
  node [shape=tab, style=filled, fillcolor=LightBlue]
  filtered     [label="Y_filtered, rowStats"]
  zscored      [label="Y_zscored"]
  svdres1      [label="svdres"]
  filteredFBM  [label="FBM_filtered, rowStats"]
  zscoredFBM   [label="FBM_zscored"]
  svdres2      [label="svdres"]
  PLIER_K      [label="PLIER_K"]
  baseResult   [label="PLIERbase.result"]
  Chat         [label="Chat"]
  Zmat         [label="Z"]
  Bmat         [label="B"]
  summaryTbl   [label="summary"]
  Umat         [label="U"]
  dotImg       [label="PLIER dot plot"]

  // ---- In‑memory branch ----
  DF -> preDF -> filtered -> zDF -> zscored -> svdDF -> svdres1 -> base -> baseResult -> full
  // ---- On‑disk branch ----
  H5 -> preFBM -> filteredFBM -> zFBM -> zscoredFBM -> svdFBM -> svdres2 -> base
  // ---- num.pc() branch ----
  svdres1 -> numpc -> PLIER_K -> full
  svdres2 -> numpc
  // ---- Prior‑knowledge branch ----
  GO -> gmtList; MSIGDB -> gmtList; GTEx -> gmtList
  gmtList -> matchPaths -> chatFunc -> Chat
  Chat -> full
  // ---- PLIERfull outputs & dotplot ----
  full -> Zmat; full -> Bmat; full -> summaryTbl -> dotplot; full -> Umat
  // ---- Connect dotplotPLIER() to your tab node ----
  dotplot -> dotImg
}
')
```

# Quick Start

We provide three self-contained examples:

1. **Data-frame example (whole blood):**  
   A small dataset loaded entirely into memory. Shows basic preprocessing, z-scoring, and running PLIER2 without on-disk storage.  

2. **HDF5 example (Alzheimer’s brain):**  
   Demonstrates how to import expression from an HDF5 file, create a file-backed FBM object, and process larger datasets using the FBM interface.

3. **Table example (pancreatic islets):**  
   Illustrates reading a tab-delimited count file, mapping ENSEMBL IDs to gene symbols, aggregating counts by gene, and comparing conditions via the B matrix.

Each example follows these steps:

1. **Load & preprocess data** (filter by mean/variance, then z-score)  
2. **Prepare pathway annotations** via `getGMT()` and construct the prior matrix  
3. **Compute SVD** (in-memory or file-backed) and infer model dimension `k`  
4. **Run PLIERbase** to initialize latent variables  
5. **Run PLIERfull** to refine with pathway priors and obtain summary statistics  


## Example 1: In-Memory data.frame (Whole Blood)

This section uses a small whole-blood RNA-Seq dataset to illustrate the in-memory workflow. No file-backed storage is required.

```{r plier2-small_example_dataframe, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Load example data
## ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
data("dataWholeBlood")    
data("majorCellTypes")

## ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Preprocess & Z-score
## ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
preproc <- preprocessPLIER2(
  Y = dataWholeBlood,
  mean_cutoff = 0.5,     
  var_cutoff = 0.1
)

# extracts the filtered matrix and its row‐stats:
dataWholeBlood <- preproc$Y_filtered    
rowStatsDF      <- preproc$rowStats    

dataWholeBlood <- zscorePLIER2(
  Y_filtered = dataWholeBlood,
  rowStats = rowStatsDF
)

## ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Prepare pathway annotations
## ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
gmtList <- list(
  GTEx_Tissues_V8_2023 = getGMT('https://maayanlab.cloud/Enrichr/geneSetLibrary?mode=text&libraryName=GTEx_Tissues_V8_2023'),
  BP = getGMT("https://maayanlab.cloud/Enrichr/geneSetLibrary?mode=text&libraryName=GO_Biological_Process_2025"),
  MSigDB_Hallmark_2020 = getGMT("https://maayanlab.cloud/Enrichr/geneSetLibrary?mode=text&libraryName=MSigDB_Hallmark_2020")
)

pathMatAll <- gmtListToSparseMat(gmtList)

matchedPathsWB <- getMatchedPathwayMat(pathMatAll, rownames(dataWholeBlood))

message("Number of distinct pathways = ", length(unique(colnames(pathMatAll))))

## ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 2. Determine SVD k and compute SVD
## ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
n_genes   <- nrow(dataWholeBlood)
n_samples <- ncol(dataWholeBlood)
SVD_K     <- min(n_genes, n_samples) - 1
message("Using SVD k = ", SVD_K)

set.seed(1)
dataWholeBlood.svd <- rsvd(dataWholeBlood, k = SVD_K)

# Precompute Chat
ChatWB <- getChat(matchedPathsWB)

## ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 3. Estimate k for PLIER via num.pc()
## ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PLIER_K <- num.pc(data = dataWholeBlood)
message("Inferred PLIERfull k = ", PLIER_K)

## ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 4. Run PLIERbase
## ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
wb.plier.base <- PLIERbase(
  Y = dataWholeBlood,
  k = PLIER_K,
  svdres = dataWholeBlood.svd,
  trace = TRUE
)

## ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 5. Run the full PLIER model
## ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
wb.plier.full <- PLIERfull(
  Y = dataWholeBlood,
  priorMat = as.matrix(matchedPathsWB),
  svdres = dataWholeBlood.svd,
  plier.base.result = wb.plier.base,
  Chat = ChatWB,
  k = PLIER_K,
  doCrossval = TRUE,
  max.U.updates = 50,
  trace = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
wb_summary <- data.frame(wb.plier.full$summary)

wb_summary %>% 
  dplyr::filter(FDR < 1e-4 & AUC > 0.7) %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(desc(AUC))
```

## Example 2: File-Backed Matrix (Alzheimer’s Brain)

Here we load an HDF5 expression file, construct a file-backed FBM, and demonstrate how PLIER2 handles larger datasets on disk.
DOI: 10.1016/j.nbd.2017.06.008

```{r plier2-small_example_fbm_full, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Load HDF5 and prepare expression matrix
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
alzheimers_path <- '/home/msubirana/Documents/pivlab/PLIER2/data/human_gene_v2.5_alz.h5'
h5 <- H5File$new(alzheimers_path, mode = "r")
expr_mat <- h5[["data/expression"]]$read()
genes <- h5[["meta/genes/symbol"]]$read()
samples <- h5[["meta/samples/geo_accession"]]$read()
h5$close_all()

expr_mat <- t(expr_mat)
colnames(expr_mat) <- samples
rownames(expr_mat) <- genes

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Create and populate FBM on disk
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
output_dir <- here("data", "alzFBM")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
fbm_file <- file.path(output_dir, "FBMalz")

alzFBM <- FBM(
  nrow = nrow(expr_mat),
  ncol = ncol(expr_mat),
  backingfile = fbm_file,
  create_bk = TRUE
)

block_size <- 1000

n_blocks   <- ceiling(nrow(expr_mat) / block_size)
for (i in seq_len(n_blocks)) {
  rows <- ((i-1) * block_size + 1):min(i * block_size, nrow(expr_mat))
  alzFBM[rows, ] <- as.matrix(expr_mat[rows, , drop = FALSE])
}

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Clean, filter, and z-score FBM
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
preproc <- preprocessPLIER2FBM(
  fbm = alzFBM,
  mean_cutoff = 0.5,
  var_cutoff = 0.1
)

fbm_filtered <- preproc$fbm_filtered
rowStats <- preproc$rowStats
kept <- preproc$kept_rows

zscorePLIER2FBM(fbm_filtered, rowStats)
meta_genes <- genes[kept]  

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Compute SVD on filtered FBM
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
SVD_K <- min(nrow(fbm_filtered), ncol(fbm_filtered)) - 1
set.seed(1)
alz_svd <- big_randomSVD(fbm_filtered, k = SVD_K)

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Prepare pathways and Chat matrix
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
gmtList <- list(
  GTEx_Tissues_V8_2023 = getGMT('https://maayanlab.cloud/Enrichr/geneSetLibrary?mode=text&libraryName=GTEx_Tissues_V8_2023'),
  BP = getGMT('https://maayanlab.cloud/Enrichr/geneSetLibrary?mode=text&libraryName=GO_Biological_Process_2025'),
  MSigDB_Hallmark_2020 = getGMT('https://maayanlab.cloud/Enrichr/geneSetLibrary?mode=text&libraryName=MSigDB_Hallmark_2020' )
)

pathMatAll <- gmtListToSparseMat(gmtList)
matchedPathsAz <- getMatchedPathwayMat(pathMatAll, meta_genes)
ChatAz <- getChat(matchedPathsAz)

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Run PLIERbase and PLIERfull
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PLIER_K  <- num.pc(list(d = alz_svd$d))
alz_base <- PLIERbase(
  Y = fbm_filtered,
  k = PLIER_K,
  svdres = alz_svd,
  trace  = TRUE
)

alz_full <- PLIERfull(
  Y = fbm_filtered,
  priorMat = matchedPathsAz,
  svdres = alz_svd,
  plier.base.result = alz_base,
  Chat = ChatAz,
  k = PLIER_K,
  doCrossval = TRUE,
  max.U.updates = 50,
  trace = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
alz_summary <- data.frame(alz_full$summary)

alz_summary %>% 
  dplyr::filter(FDR < 1e-4 & AUC > 0.7) %>% 
  arrange(FDR)
```

## Example 3: Tab-Delimited Count File (Pancreatic Islets)

In this example, we import raw count data, map ENSEMBL identifiers to gene symbols, aggregate counts, and then apply the dense (in-memory) pipeline. Finally, we compare latent-variable activities between control and diabetic donors.

https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE164416

```{r plier2-small_example_table, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Load count data and map to gene symbols
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
islet_df <- read.table(
  here::here('/home/msubirana/Documents/pivlab/PLIER2/data/GSE164416_DP_htseq_counts.txt'),
  header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

islet_df$symbol <- mapIds(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys = islet_df$ensembl,
  column = "SYMBOL",
  keytype = "ENSEMBL",
  multiVals = "first"
)

islet_df <- islet_df[!is.na(islet_df$symbol), ]

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Aggregate counts by gene symbol
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
setDT(islet_df)
num_cols <- names(islet_df)[sapply(islet_df, is.numeric)]
expr <- islet_df[, lapply(.SD, sum), by = symbol, .SDcols = num_cols]
expr <- as.data.frame(expr)
rownames(expr) <- expr$symbol
expr$symbol <- NULL
expr <- as.matrix(expr)

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Preprocess & Z-score (dense)
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
preproc <- preprocessPLIER2(
  Y = expr,
  mean_cutoff = 0.5,
  var_cutoff = 0.1
)

expr_filt <- preproc$Y_filtered
rowStats <- preproc$rowStats

expr_z <- zscorePLIER2(
  Y_filtered = expr_filt,
  rowStats = rowStats
)

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Prepare pathways and Chat matrix
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
gmtList <- list(
  GTEx_Tissues_V8_2023 = getGMT('https://maayanlab.cloud/Enrichr/geneSetLibrary?mode=text&libraryName=GTEx_Tissues_V8_2023'),
  Diabetes_Perturbations_GEO_2022 = getGMT('https://maayanlab.cloud/Enrichr/geneSetLibrary?mode=text&libraryName=Diabetes_Perturbations_GEO_2022'),
  MSigDB_Hallmark_2020 = getGMT('https://maayanlab.cloud/Enrichr/geneSetLibrary?mode=text&libraryName=MSigDB_Hallmark_2020')
)

pathMatAll   <- gmtListToSparseMat(gmtList)
matchedPaths <- getMatchedPathwayMat(pathMatAll, rownames(expr_z))
Chat <- getChat(matchedPaths)
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Run PLIERbase and PLIERfull
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
base_res <- PLIERbase(
  Y = expr_z,
  k = num.pc(expr_z),
  svdres = rsvd(expr_z, k = min(nrow(expr_z), ncol(expr_z)) - 1),
  trace = TRUE
)

full_res <- PLIERfull(
  Y = expr_z,
  priorMat = matchedPaths,
  svdres = base_res$svdres,
  plier.base.result = base_res,
  Chat = Chat,
  k = num.pc(expr_z),
  doCrossval = TRUE,
  trace = TRUE
)

```

```{r}
islets_summary <- full_res$summary

islets_summary_sig <- islets_summary %>% 
  dplyr::rename(LV='LV index') %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(LV=paste0('LV', LV)) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(FDR<1e-4 & AUC > 0.7)

islets_summary_sig %>% dplyr::arrange(desc(AUC))
```

```{r}
iselt_metadata <- read.csv('/home/msubirana/Documents/pivlab/PLIER2/data/islets_metadata.csv', header = TRUE)
```

```{r}
B_df <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(full_res$B)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(LV = rownames(.))

sample_types <- iselt_metadata %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    id   = as.character(id),
    type = as.character(type)
  )

sample_cols  <- setdiff(colnames(B_df), "LV")
nd_cols      <- intersect(sample_cols, sample_types$id[sample_types$type == "ND"])
other_cols   <- intersect(sample_cols, sample_types$id[sample_types$type != "ND"])

if (length(nd_cols) == 0 || length(other_cols) == 0) {
  stop("No matching ND or non-ND sample columns found")
}

lv_stats_all_vs_nd <- B_df %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Mean_ND   = mean(dplyr::c_across(dplyr::all_of(nd_cols))),
    Mean_All  = mean(dplyr::c_across(dplyr::all_of(other_cols))),
    Mean_Diff = Mean_All - Mean_ND,
    P_Value   = stats::wilcox.test(
      dplyr::c_across(dplyr::all_of(nd_cols)),
      dplyr::c_across(dplyr::all_of(other_cols))
    )$p.value
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(FDR = stats::p.adjust(P_Value, method = "fdr")) %>%
  dplyr::select(LV, Mean_ND, Mean_All, Mean_Diff, P_Value, FDR) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(FDR)

sig_lv_all_vs_nd <- lv_stats_all_vs_nd %>%
  dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05)

sig_pathway <- islets_summary %>% 
  dplyr::rename(LV='LV index') %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(LV=paste0('LV', LV)) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(FDR<1e-4 & AUC > 0.7) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(LV %in% sig_lv_all_vs_nd$LV) %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(FDR)

sig_pathway
```
